lesson: Situation: pseudobulk input was fed into log-CPM/limma-voom normalization without checking if it was already log-normalized upstream. Lesson: always verify the input's normalization state before applying a normalization step.

Situation: a study design cited a paper for a mechanistic pathway claim (JAK/STAT) that overstated what the source text actually supported. Lesson: verify mechanistic or pathway claims against the full source text before including them in a design.

Situation: study design for age-associated T cell changes (ABF300) proposed only descriptive cross-tabs (sex x age-decade, batch x age-decade) to check confounding among covariates. Lesson: Round-0 diagnostics must include a formal collinearity check (e.g. VIF or pairwise correlation/eta-squared) on the exact covariate set entering each regression model (age, sex, batch, depth), not just coarse cross-tabs, before finalizing the statistical approach.

Situation: a positive control literally named as a joint/co-expression marker set (NKG2C+GZMB- CD8 decline, Terekhova 2024) was tested using a single-gene (KLRC2) whole-lineage average instead of a per-cell joint gate on both markers, and failed to recover as a result. Lesson: when a literature control is defined by co-expression of 2+ markers, test it with a per-cell joint gate on the single-cell matrix (e.g. KLRC2+/GZMB- per cell), not a single-gene proxy or independently-tested genes — a single-gene substitute is a different, weaker claim than the one being validated.
